title: OQ-10 (A): 'end lesson' in a lesson that started from an answer, before anything is tried: end_lesson is called, nothing is recorded, and the reply ends on the hand-back line in place of the pick-it-up sentence

steps.text: Select Title's Position, Scale and Opacity keys and choose Easy Ease (F9), so it lands softer.
Play it back and watch how Title lands.

say_ends_with.pattern: ^That was step 1[;.] next is (?:step 2: )?(?:to )?play it back and watch how Title lands

note: Spec 014 T079 (OQ-10: 'a stop in a go-deeper lesson'; the skill: 'When either tool's reply has hand_back, end on its hand-back line in place of the pick-it-up sentence'). The panel's own wording for the stop isn't pinned: 'end lesson' is what case 63 and T038 used.
